name: Rushikulya

source.name: Headwater tributary in the Ghumusar hills, Eastern Ghats

significance: mouth at Puruna Bandha is one of the world's largest mass-nesting (arribada) sites for Olive Ridley sea turtles
flows through Surada, Dharakote, Asika and Purusottampur before Ganjam and Chhatrapur
did_you_know: The Rushikulya's traced main channel climbs into the Ghumusar hills rather than the popularly-cited Daringbadi spring — Wikipedia's own source coordinate for Daringbadi (19.07°N) looks like a transcription slip, since Daringbadi actually sits at about 19.9°N.
Mass nesting of Olive Ridley turtles at the river's mouth typically occurs between January and March, drawing conservationists from across the world.
